title: platystachys utriculata
intro: Platystachys utriculata, commonly known as Chinese skullcap, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Platystachys utriculata include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Platystachys utriculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
